plugins.name: ahoo-fetcher-skills
plugins.description: Skills for building with Fetcher 6, the TypeScript HTTP client on native fetch: fetcher (client, interceptors, errors, decorator services, SSE/OpenAI streaming, event buses, storage, CoSec auth, OpenAPI types), fetcher-react (React hooks) and fetcher-v6-migration (upgrading from 5.x). Wow CQRS clients and OpenAPI client generation live in the Wow repository's skills.

interface.defaultPrompt: Help me build with Fetcher 6 — HTTP clients, decorator services, streaming, auth, storage, React hooks — or upgrade a project from Fetcher 5.x to 6.0.
